description: This PHP file defines the OverlapLeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API Model namespace. The class extends LeaveModel and represents a data model for related leave overlaps, including properties such as id, date, duration, status, leave request, leave type, start/end times, duration type, and last comment. It includes methods for constructing the model with a Leave object and converting it to an array for serialization, with additional logic to include the last comment details if available.

classes.name: OverlapLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class representing overlapping leave information, including properties for leave details and last comment, extending LeaveModel and providing customized toArray logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OverlapLeaveModel with a Leave entity and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model to an array representation, augmenting with last comment details if available.
